newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Adcorp buys rest of firm for 21.8 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Adcorp buys rest of firm for 21.8 mln rand.

text.p: Adcorp Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired the remaining 50 percent of Research Surveys (Pty) Ltd in a deal worth 21.8 million rand.
The vendors will receive 1.75 million rand in cash and 12 million rand through the issue of 1.6 million shares in Adcorp at a price of 7.50 rand a share.
They will be paid a further 8.05 million in cash following a placement, agreed in June, with institutions of 1.4 million Adcorp shares to be issued at 5.75 rand.
The deal would have had no material impact on Adcorp results for the six months to June 30, 1996, the company said in a statement.
Chairman John Barry said that Adcorp, which has held a stake in Research Surveys since 1990, had benefitted from synergy in communications and mamagement.
The further acquisition gave Adcorp a strong international presence and a sound platform for sustainable growth in offshore earnings, he said.
